sections.label: Changi Airport air links lost
sections.summary: Changi Airport has lost about 50% of its air links and over 95% of scheduled passenger services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Changi Airport has lost about 50% of its air links and over 95% of scheduled passenger services.

sections.label: RTS Link and HSR talks
sections.summary: Singapore and Malaysia agreed to resume the RTS Link Project, and discussions continue on the suspended Kuala Lumpur-Singapore HSR Project.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Last month, Singapore and Malaysia agreed to resume the Johor Bahru – Singapore Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link Project.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: When service commences in 2026, it will ease Causeway congestion, improve connectivity and deepen people-to-people ties.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: We are also in discussions with Malaysia on the Kuala Lumpur – Singapore High Speed Rail (HSR) Project, which has been suspended at Malaysia's request until 31 December 2020.

sections.label: Rail and bus improvements
sections.summary: MOT has improved rail and bus services, with MRT Mean Kilometres Between Failure rising from 130,000 to over one million train-km.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Over the last five years, MOT has significantly improved rail and bus services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: We have turned the corner on rail reliability, with Mean Kilometres Between Failure of the Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) system increasing from 130,000 train-km to over one million train-km.

sections.label: Cleaner buses and vehicle growth
sections.summary: Vehicle growth rate is 0%, the Government will buy only cleaner energy buses, and aims to phase out internal combustion engine private vehicles by 2040.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Our vehicle growth rate is already 0%, and the Government will henceforth purchase only cleaner energy buses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: We will further work towards phasing out private vehicles with internal combustion engines by 2040.

sections.label: Pedestrianisation and cycling paths
sections.summary: There may be scope to pedestrianise certain roads, and cycling paths will expand from 460km to around 1,300km by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: There may be scope to pedestrianise certain roads.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: We will also follow through on our plan to expand cycling paths from 460km now to around 1,300km by 2030 under the Islandwide Cycling Network.

sections.label: Maritime decarbonisation efforts
sections.summary: Singapore set up an International Advisory Panel on Maritime Decarbonisation and a Maritime GreenFuture Fund to develop and adopt low-carbon technologies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Internationally, we will play our part to tackle climate change.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: We have set up an International Advisory Panel on Maritime Decarbonisation to develop strategies for maritime decarbonisation, and started a Maritime GreenFuture Fund to accelerate the development and adoption of low-carbon technologies.
